dialogue.content: (スナフキンさま　今日もよろしくお願いします。）準備ができましたら、お声掛けください。）
dialogue.English: (Mr./Ms. Snufkin, thank you for joining me today. Please let me know when you are ready.)

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: （それでは開始させていただきます。）
dialogue.English: (Then, let's begin.)

dialogue.content: 了解しました
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です今日はどのような相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm your counselor. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 仕事が上手く行かなくて退職しました
dialogue.English: I quit my job because things weren't going well.

dialogue.content: それは心配ですね
dialogue.English: That must be worrying.

dialogue.content: これまで何度も仕事につきましたが、どこでも上手く行かなかった
dialogue.English: I've had many jobs before, but none of them ever worked out.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 私が悪いんです
dialogue.English: It's my fault.

dialogue.content: そう思われるんですね
dialogue.English: So that's how you see it.

dialogue.content: ダメな人間だから
dialogue.English: Because I'm a worthless person.

dialogue.content: そんなふうにご自分を責めてしまうのですね・・
dialogue.English: So you end up blaming yourself like that...

dialogue.content: お辛いですね
dialogue.English: That must be painful.

dialogue.content: 生きてる意味が解らないです
dialogue.English: I don't see the point in living.

dialogue.content: どのようなことで、そう思われるのかお話を伺ってもいいですか？
dialogue.English: May I ask what leads you to feel that way?

dialogue.content: どんな仕事をしても人間関係でつまづくんです
dialogue.English: No matter what job I have, I always stumble when it comes to interpersonal relationships.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what's been happening...

dialogue.content: 昔から人とは少し違うなと思ってたんですが、大学までは自分がおかしいって気付かなかった
dialogue.English: I've always felt I was a little different from others, but I didn't realize there was something wrong with me until after college.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 仕事を始めてからはトラブル続きであんまり上手くいかないから医者に行ってみて分かったんです
dialogue.English: After I started working, I had one problem after another and things weren't going well, so I went to a doctor and found out.

dialogue.content: 今まで頑張ってきたことの意味がなかった
dialogue.English: It meant that everything I had worked so hard for was meaningless.

dialogue.content: 初めから知っていたら良かったのに
dialogue.English: I wish I had known from the beginning.

dialogue.content: どんなことがわかったのでしょうか？お聞きしてもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May I ask what you found out?

dialogue.content: 重い発達障害だって言われました
dialogue.English: I was told I have a severe developmental disorder.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see... so that's what it was.

dialogue.content: 人と上手くやっていけないんです
dialogue.English: I can't get along well with people.

dialogue.content: だからちゃんと働く事ができない
dialogue.English: That's why I can't hold down a proper job.

dialogue.content: それはとまどってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: That must be very confusing and overwhelming.

dialogue.content: こんな人間が生きている意味がありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there any point in a person like me being alive?

dialogue.content: 働けない人間なんて、人に迷惑をかけるだけの存在で、いない方がいいんです
dialogue.English: Someone who can't work is just a burden to others. It would be better if they weren't around.

dialogue.content: 自分に病名がついてしまい、ショックだったかと思います
dialogue.English: Receiving a diagnosis must have been a shock.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも、障害は自分のせいではないですよね？
dialogue.English: But the disorder isn't your fault, is it?

dialogue.content: でも、スッキリした気持ちもありました今までよく解らずに苦しんできたことが、そうだったんだって納得できた
dialogue.English: But there was also a sense of relief. I could finally understand why I had been suffering for so long without knowing the reason.

dialogue.content: 生まれたことが誤りだったんです
dialogue.English: My being born was a mistake.

dialogue.content: 本当に、なんでだろう・・って苦しかったでしょうね
dialogue.English: It must have been really painful, wondering, "Why is this happening..."

dialogue.content: 直接人に言われたこともあるんです
dialogue.English: People have said it to my face before.

dialogue.content: 今まで本当によく頑張ったこられたと思います
dialogue.English: I think you have truly persevered through so much.

dialogue.content: お前なんて何の役にも立たないから生きてる意味がない迷惑なだけだって
dialogue.English: They told me, "You're useless, there's no point in you being alive; you're just a nuisance."

dialogue.content: そんなひどいことを・・
dialogue.English: What a terrible thing to say...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 職場の方からでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Was that from someone at work?

dialogue.content: でも、その人の言う通りだと思います
dialogue.English: But I think what they said is true.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 前に働いてた所の人です
dialogue.English: It was someone from my previous job.

dialogue.content: いいえ、生きている意味のない人などこの世の中には一人もいません
dialogue.English: No—there is no one in this world whose life has no meaning.

dialogue.content: そうですかね
dialogue.English: Do you really think so?

dialogue.content: 役に立たない人間は、他の人の幸せを邪魔するだけだからいない方がいいと思うんです
dialogue.English: I think people who are useless only get in the way of others' happiness, so it's better if they weren't around.

dialogue.content: みんなそれぞれに価値があって生きている、と思います
dialogue.English: I believe everyone has their own worth and is living for a reason.

dialogue.content: どうしてそういえるのですか？
dialogue.English: How can you say that?

dialogue.content: どうしましたか？
dialogue.English: What's wrong?

dialogue.content: やっぱり答えられないですよね
dialogue.English: You can't answer after all, right?

dialogue.content: あなたが自分のことを役に立たない人間だと、思ってしまうのはその方から言われたことのせいもあるように思いますが、いかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: I wonder if part of the reason you see yourself as useless might be because of what that person said to you. What do you think?

dialogue.content: （すみませんパソコンがかたまって送信遅くなりました）
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry, my computer froze and my response was delayed.)

dialogue.content: 確かに言われた時はショックだったけれど、それ以前から自分でも感じていたことだから
dialogue.English: It was certainly a shock when they said it, but I'd felt that way myself even before then.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see, so that was the case...

dialogue.content: 生きている意味が解らないのに、死ぬ勇気もない私って本当にどうしうようもない人間だと思います
dialogue.English: I don't see the point in living, but I don't have the courage to die. I think I'm truly a hopeless person.

dialogue.content: 本当に今までお辛かったと思います
dialogue.English: I can only imagine how painful it must have been for you all this time.

dialogue.content: 自分のせいなので仕方ないです
dialogue.English: It's my own fault, so it can't be helped.

dialogue.content: お仕事自体は充実されていたのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Did you find the work itself fulfilling?

dialogue.content: トラブルが多くてダメでした
dialogue.English: There were too many problems, so it didn't work out.

dialogue.content: 興味のあるお仕事をされてきたのだと思います
dialogue.English: I imagine you've been doing work you were interested in.

dialogue.content: トラブルというのは、人間関係だけせしょうか？
dialogue.English: Were the troubles only related to interpersonal relationships?

dialogue.content: ミスとか勘違いとかもいっぱいありましたよ指示されたことと違うことをやってしまったりしたことが多かったですね
dialogue.English: There were also lots of mistakes and misunderstandings. I often ended up doing something different from what I was instructed to do.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・大変な思いをされてきたのですね
dialogue.English: I see... You've really been through a lot.

dialogue.content: じぶんとしては言われた通りやってるのに、そんなこと頼んだつもりはないって言われたりして
dialogue.English: From my perspective, I was doing exactly as I was told, but then I'd be told, "That's not what I asked you to do."

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: どしてなんだかずっと解らなかったけれど、医者に聞いてからやっと解ったんです
dialogue.English: I never understood why for the longest time, but after talking to the doctor, I finally got it.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 今までずっと悩まれてきたんですね
dialogue.English: You've been struggling with this for a long time, haven't you?

dialogue.content: 仕方ないですよ役に立たないんだから
dialogue.English: It can't be helped. I'm useless.

dialogue.content: わかったことで、スッキリした気持ちとじゃあ、これからどうしようか・・という戸惑いの気持ちがあるのではないでしょうか
dialogue.English: Now that you know, perhaps you feel a sense of relief, but also a sense of confusion, wondering, "So, what do I do now?"

dialogue.content: 努力したって無駄だって思いましたそんな人間が生きていたら申し訳ないとも
dialogue.English: I felt that any effort would be pointless. I also feel apologetic for even being alive, like I'm a burden.

dialogue.content: そんなふうに考えてしまわれたんですね
dialogue.English: So that's how you came to think about it.

dialogue.content: どうしたら死ぬ勇気がもてるんですかね？
dialogue.English: How can I find the courage to die?

dialogue.content: 死んでしまいたいほど、お辛い気持ちになってしまったんですね・・
dialogue.English: You're feeling so much pain that you feel like you want to die...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 診断して下さった医師はどんなふうに言われてましたか？
dialogue.English: What did the doctor who diagnosed you say?

dialogue.content: 症状によってはお薬で良い方向に行く方も多いと聞いています
dialogue.English: I've heard that depending on the symptoms, many people improve with medication.

dialogue.content: 他人の意図をくみとるのが難しいと言われました
dialogue.English: I was told it's difficult for me to grasp other people's intentions.

dialogue.content: 対処法を考えて下さる医師もいらっしゃるかと思います
dialogue.English: I believe there are doctors who can help you think through coping strategies.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 薬は抗不安薬とか、抗鬱薬とか、睡眠薬とかしかもらってないです
dialogue.English: As for medication, I've only been given things like anti-anxiety medication, antidepressants, and sleeping pills.

dialogue.content: 発達障害の診断には心理検査などして診断することが多いかとおもいますが、検査とかはされましたか？
dialogue.English: Diagnoses for developmental disorders often involve psychological tests. Did you have any tests done?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 検査結果では発達障害ののデコボコが良くわかる検査だと思いますが、あなたはどんなふうに受けとめられましたか？
dialogue.English: Those test results tend to show the uneven profile of developmental disorders quite clearly. How did you take the results?

dialogue.content: 多動性も自閉症スペクトラムも両方あるけど、後の方が強いって感じかな
dialogue.English: It's like I have both hyperactivity and autism spectrum, but the latter is stronger.

dialogue.content: なるほどって思いました
dialogue.English: I thought, "That makes sense."

dialogue.content: ASDの傾向が強かったということでしょうか
dialogue.English: So, the ASD tendencies were stronger?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: そうだったなら、子供の頃からきっとずっとしんどい思いをされてきたのではないでしょうか
dialogue.English: If that's the case, you must have been having a very hard time ever since you were a child.

dialogue.content: ほんとうによく耐えてこられましたね
dialogue.English: You've truly endured so much.

dialogue.content: 浮いているなとは思いましたが、そのことをそれほど深刻には感じてきませんでした仲間外れはあったけれど、酷いいじめとかは受けなかったし運が良かったのかもしれません
dialogue.English: I did feel like I didn't fit in, but I didn't take it too seriously. I was left out at times, but I was never severely bullied, so maybe I was lucky.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: はいひとりでいることをそれほど苦痛には感じなかったんです
dialogue.English: Yes, I didn't find being alone all that painful.

dialogue.content: それはあなたの長所ですね
dialogue.English: That's one of your strengths.

dialogue.content: どうなんでしょうね
dialogue.English: I wonder about that.

dialogue.content: 一人でいる時間を大切に思っているってことですよね
dialogue.English: It means you value your time alone, right?

dialogue.content: 人からどういこう言われなくていいです
dialogue.English: I prefer not to have people telling me this and that.

dialogue.content: 今までほかの人から言われたことがなかったのに、社会人になってバランスがとれなくなってしまったんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You hadn't been told things like that by others before, but did you lose your balance after becoming a working adult?

dialogue.content: 仕事となると自分だけの世界にいられないですからね
dialogue.English: When it comes to work, you can't just stay in your own world.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・・今までのお話を伺って感じたことをお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: That's true... Based on what you've told me so far, may I share my thoughts?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたは、今までお仕事で人間関係でつまづいてしまい転職をされてきて発達障害の診断を受けて、ようやく今までのトラブルの原因がわかりすっきりはしたのですが、まだ自分ではその障害を受け入れることができていないのでは？と思いました
dialogue.English: It seems that you've stumbled with interpersonal relationships at work, changed jobs, and then received a diagnosis of a developmental disorder. And while you finally understand the cause of your past troubles, which brought some clarity, I wonder if you haven't yet been able to accept the disorder yourself. That's the impression I got.

dialogue.content: そうなのかな？
dialogue.English: I wonder if that's the case.

dialogue.content: 発達障害も自分の個性だと考えられるようになれば、少し楽になれるのでは・・と思いますが・・いかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: If you could come to think of your developmental disorder as part of your individuality, you might feel a bit more at ease... What do you think?

dialogue.content: 原因がわかれば、きっと対策もたてられるのでは？と思うのですが・・
dialogue.English: Now that you know the cause, I believe it's surely possible to develop some strategies...

dialogue.content: 個性で通用するほど、今までの職場は甘くはなかったです
dialogue.English: The workplaces I've been in weren't lenient enough to accept it as "individuality."

dialogue.content: そうですよねお辛い思いをされてきたんですよね・・
dialogue.English: You're right. You've been through so much pain...

dialogue.content: そんな目処は全く立ちませんが、お話を聞いてもらえて少しは落ち着くことができました
dialogue.English: I don't see any prospect of that happening, but I was able to calm down a little by having you listen to me.

dialogue.content: また相談にくてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: Is it okay if I come for counseling again?

dialogue.content: また相談に来てもいいですか？
dialogue.English: Is it okay if I come for counseling again?

dialogue.content: はい大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, of course.

dialogue.content: あなたが、少しでもご自分を受け入れてありのままに生きていけたらいいな、と思っています
dialogue.English: I hope that you can accept yourself, even just a little, and live as you are.

dialogue.content: 今まで誰にも気持ちを解ってもらえなかったので
dialogue.English: Because until now, no one has ever understood how I feel.

dialogue.content: お辛い中、ほんとうに頑張ってこられました
dialogue.English: You have truly persevered through all this pain.

dialogue.content: あなたに合ったお仕事が、今度こそ見つかりますように応援しています
dialogue.English: I'm rooting for you to find a job that's right for you this time.

dialogue.content: まだ死にたい気持ちはありますが、他の可能性も考えてみます
dialogue.English: I still feel like I want to die, but I'll try to consider other possibilities.

dialogue.content: 生きていればきっといいこともあるかと思います
dialogue.English: If you keep living, I believe good things are sure to happen.

dialogue.content: うーん
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: 発達障害の相談機関もありますし、同じ症状で悩んでいる方もいるはずなので、あなたひとりではないと思います
dialogue.English: There are support organizations for developmental disorders, and there must be others struggling with the same symptoms, so I don't think you are alone.

dialogue.content: そういう機関に相談してはいますが、中々上手く行ってないんです
dialogue.English: I have been consulting those kinds of organizations, but it's not going very well.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: ひとりで抱え込まずに、またこちらにお話にきてくださいね
dialogue.English: Please don't try to carry it all by yourself. Come and talk to me again.

dialogue.content: はいまた、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you again.

dialogue.content: 今回は時間がなくなってしまいましたが、大事なことなのでぜひ、一緒に考えていきたいと思います
dialogue.English: We've run out of time for today, but this is important, so I'd really like for us to continue thinking it through together.

dialogue.content: 今日は相談に来て下さりありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in for counseling today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: No, thank you.

dialogue.content: また、次回もお待ちしております。
dialogue.English: I look forward to seeing you again next time.

dialogue.content: では終了にさせて頂いてもよろしいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Well then, may I end the session now?

dialogue.content: いいですよお疲れさまでした。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine. Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: （途中でパソコンが固まってしまい送信がかなりの時間でできずにご迷惑と心配をおかけしました。申し訳ございませんでした）
dialogue.English: (My computer froze partway through, and I couldn't send messages for quite a while. I apologize for the trouble and for worrying you.)

dialogue.content: （今日はとても難しいケースありがとうございました。勉強になりました。終了ボタン押しますね）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for this very challenging case today. It was a learning experience. I'm pressing the end button now.)

dialogue.content: 了解しました。
dialogue.English: Understood.
